free_resources.title: Meditacija – vodič za početnike (Meditation: a beginner's guide)
free_resources.description: A free guide in Croatian to starting a daily meditation practice: when and where to sit, choosing a posture and a point of focus such as a mantra, an image or counting the breath. It also covers what to do when the mind wanders or discomfort comes, and how to notice progress.

left_out: 'Yoga i zdravlje' (yoga and health) page: still left out; it claims yoga poses strengthen the immune system, speed recovery from illness and prevent high and low blood pressure.
flags: Meditation guide: says meditation teaches us to handle stress and that less stress improves overall health; general wellbeing language, no claim to treat a condition. Kept under the new rule.
